name: ColorPicker
summary: Color selection control. Two variants — swatches (a fixed palette of brand-safe color stops, the operator default) and full (saturation/lightness pad + hue slider + hex input + eyedropper). Always paired with a hex / rgba text input so users with vision differences can type the value.

swatches.description: Array of allowed values. Defaults to the Lumen brand palette.

keyboard: ArrowKeys - move within the saturation pad (variant='full')
Tab to hex input - manually enter a color
rules: Each swatch carries aria-label='Hex {value}' so SR users hear the value, not just see it.
Selected swatch has aria-pressed='true' + a 2 px ring.
Hex input is always available as a fallback path.

do: Default to swatches variant inside operator surfaces — restricted palette = consistent design.
Pair with a Tooltip on each swatch announcing the hex.
Show the current value as text under the picker (the hex / rgba string).
Use ColorPicker for brand colors / theme tokens; for free-form color, use variant='full'.
dont: Don't render the full picker on a single brand-color settings page.
Don't omit the text input — color-blind users need keyboard entry.
Don't lime-fill the picker chrome — the swatches are the values.

changelog.note: Initial ColorPicker contract (beta). Swatches + full variants.
